scope: Native publisher source, whole synthetic fixtures and offline protocol/HTTP/storage tests. No real private/current/provider data or native invocation.
semantics: Reject malformed snapshot before a reservation; reacquire complete actual snapshot after revision allocation
Keep source ETag opaque and snapshot value digest typed; generation and acquisition time remain distinct
Before S3 replacement retain every predecessor byte in the existing private archive
Use IfMatch or IfNoneMatch on every current write, reread on conflict, never unconditional fallback
Reject older/equal-conflicting publication revisions; new attempts obtain durable counter rank
Source HEAD fences known changes and the existing UI snapshot-binding check remains mandatory
Exact canonical candidate bytes reach both stores; ack must bind protocol, revision and body digest
Explicit superseded/changed/partial states; transport failures never become success
No redirects or unreviewed publication origin; bounded complete strict UTF-8 acknowledgement
Read-only native operation requires exactly original six source closure members plus portfolio_publication.py and unchanged original resources/schedules
limitations: S3 and mirror are separate commits; the stores are not globally atomic
Source HEAD checks are not an atomic cross-key transaction
In-flight legacy Lambda writes remain possible during the original 300-second runtime window
Same-attempt exact retry is safe; after a failed invocation the next normal run reserves a new rank and recalculates
Native receipt prerequisite requires Worker evidence already retained in the checkout; deploy the backward-compatible Worker phase first
Actual normal private publication and runtime SDK behavior remain unverified by read-only acceptance
